decisions.reason: The reporting dimensions do not change which communication channels are visible on HubSpot lead records.
The source defines funnel reporting and notes the absence of a Leads Table, but it does not change HubSpot list-creation or list-management behavior.
A report broken down by funnel stage does not alter how MeetAlfred replies populate the HubSpot Lead Status field.
The reporting change does not modify the direction, objects, or automatic behavior of HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization.
Grouping HubSpot reports by Contact Source does not change the LinkedIn-to-HubSpot transfer path or its transfer semantics.
The funnel-report specification does not change how new MeetAlfred campaigns or their Zapier integrations are created.
The source changes HubSpot report content only and does not alter email integration between MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
Contact Source reporting does not resolve or modify which LinkedIn URL is retained in the CRM.
The requested report grouping and conversion metric do not change Apollo enrichment data or enrichment behavior.
Using Contact Source as a reporting group does not modify silent-lead recirculation or follow-up export behavior.
Permission to experiment with unassigned Contact Source records does not change the separate MeetAlfred test-data safety policies.
The reporting specification neither changes nor resolves how existing CRM records are identified during LinkedIn lead transfer.
